name: lumina-reader
description: Modular cross-platform book reader with realistic 3D page flip animation

scripts.build:android: bun run build && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: bun run build && cap sync android && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace -w /workspace/android -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/tmp/.gradle lumina-android-builder:latest bash -c './gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon && chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) /workspace/android' && mkdir -p release && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk release/lumina-reader-android.apk
